propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective emits false-positive warnings on every small call with input_tokens below the 4096-token cache floor, even though zero cache counters are the correct and expected result below that floor

The warning predicate checks only input_tokens > 0 without consulting the documented CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS floor, making it unable to distinguish a genuinely uncacheable prompt from a cacheable prompt that silently failed to cache

The warning contradicts the run's aggregate telemetry: runs with cache_write_tokens > 0 still emit per-call warnings for sub-floor calls, training operators to filter out the signal that catches real cache defects
The CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant is defined in pass1.py but the warning in structured_run.py uses only a bare input_tokens check, creating two separate sources of truth for the same model fact
The fix gates the warning on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and moves the constant to a shared home in capabilities.py so both pass1.py and structured_run.py reference one definition
